intro.text: A girl from Hearthstone in Alethkar.

items.text: At fifteen, Sani badly hurt her safehand and was treated by Lirin and his ten-year-old son Kaladin, who arrived late to find her already sedated with winterwort. Kaladin tried to stay calm and focus on the work.

Her fingers had been badly set and the wound poorly cleaned. Kaladin rightly saw that a finger with a compound fracture had to come off; Lirin removed it, splinted the others and cleaned the hand. Kaladin expected her family to be angry about the finger, but still to make a donation.

appearance.text: A beautiful darkeyed girl with black hair, who has only four fingers on her left hand after her injury.
